description: Golden corpus for ζ production-pipeline regression. Each entry is a known-good Quartus RBF with a SHA256 anchor; zeta_regression.py asserts that ζ → fasm2rbf round-trips byte-identical and that the region-cell counts still match. Missing fixtures are skipped with a warning; present-but-SHA-drifted fixtures fail loud.

base.note: ζ XOR baseline; gitignored but must be present locally.

entries.name: two_lab
entries.notes: First cross-LAB fabric route confirmed on silicon. Selftest invariant: 1710 bits.

entries.name: lits_pair_y11_dataa
entries.design: single-LAB route X10Y10 → X10Y11N0.dataa (sig-cache mining template)
entries.notes: Route-family fixture; exercises LI MUX cell emission through ζ. HW config-chain validated on AX301 2026-04-24 (ζ pipeline flash gate OK; RBF config accepted, DONE pin asserted). Functional LED behavior not asserted — mining-template masks (LUT1=0xA0A0, LUT2=0xFF00) don't drive predictable output for a human observer.

entries.name: lits_pair_y11_datab
entries.design: single-LAB route X10Y10 → X10Y11N0.datab (port variant of the y11_dataa fixture)
entries.notes: Sibling of y11_dataa; differs only in destination port (tests port isolation). HW config-chain validated on AX301 2026-04-24 (ζ pipeline flash gate OK).

entries.name: neorv32_demo
entries.design: NEORV32 bootloader (4712 LE / 2367 DFF / 19 M9K / 51 pins) — production-scale RISC-V SoC; HW-validated via ζ end-to-end at 19200-8N1 on AX301 (2026-04-23)
entries.notes: Fixture sourced from ~/see_neorv32_run_linux/output/neorv32_demo.rbf; copied locally under tmp/zeta_fixtures/ (gitignored). Proves the corpus scales to full-NEORV32 designs.

entries.name: neorv32_demo_v2
entries.design: NEORV32 bootloader, v2 drill variant — identical to neorv32_demo except IO_UART0_TX_FIFO=5 (32-entry) instead of 4 (16-entry). Quartus 21.1 re-fit touches 1419/1752 fabric frames; pair with neorv32_demo for manifest/rbf drift diffing.
entries.notes: Rebuilt by zeta_pipeline on 2026-04-24 from tmp/neorv32_v2/v2/quartus; Quartus 21.1 is deterministic for this project (v1 rebuild matches the shipped neorv32_demo fixture byte-for-byte). HW-validated on AX301 2026-04-24: all 5 ζ pipeline gates passed (flash + UART match 'CMD:>' prompt at 19200-8N1 — bootloader reaches interactive mode after the expected SPI-flash ERROR_DEVICE fallback). Fixture gitignored alongside v1; see tmp/neorv32_v2/DIFF_REPORT.md for the drift analysis.

entries.name: cross_lab_x33
entries.design: cross_lab.v at X=33 jailbreak column — q1<=key2&key3 (SLICE_X33_Y4_N4) -> led0<=q1 (SLICE_X33_Y4_N6); E16+M16+G15+E1; first AX301 silicon-validated zero-Quartus open-toolchain run for an X=33 design
entries.notes: Reference build: tmp/x33_lut_mining/cl_and/cl_and.rbf (Quartus). HW-validated on AX301 2026-05-03 (LED0 = key2 & key3, both keys released -> on, either pressed -> off). Catches regressions in: X=33 per-nibble LUT codec, X33Y4_CROSS_LAB_SHIM activation guard, Phase-3 LI restore + post-restore override application order, LAB_CLK_SEL_LE X=33 skip + ROUTE X=33 skip + IOB_IN E16/M16 X=33 column-strip filter.

entries.name: nv_zero_global_self
entries.design: the ζ baseline used against itself — ζ must emit 0 BIT directives and fasm2rbf must return a byte-identical copy
entries.notes: Edge case: empty-FASM round-trip. Catches regressions where fasm2rbf perturbs CRC on zero-directive input.
